Hero262.heading: An SEO Team That Gets to Know Your Business
Hero262.description:
Before we recommend what to change on your website, we want to know how your business works. Which customers are the best fit? What do they need to know before they buy? Where do you want to grow next?

Those answers shape what we do. We work directly with your team, explain why each priority matters and help put the plan into practice. When results fall short, we investigate. When your plans change, we adjust the strategy with you.

Some clients have worked with us for more than seven years. Over time, we’ve helped teams through website launches, migrations and expansion into new markets. Knowing your business well helps us see what needs attention now and where the next opportunity might be.

FounderLetter.heading: From the Owner
FounderLetter.quote:
Conversion Century is much more than a company to me. I have grown alongside it, dedicated my professional life to SEO and built a team of people who care about our clients as deeply as I do. That is why I remain personally involved in every business that places its trust in us.

When we take on a client, I want to understand what they are building, why it matters and what success would mean for their company. Their website becomes something I think about, question and genuinely want to improve, not simply another project in a report.

That commitment also requires honesty. We accept projects where we believe we can create meaningful value, and we expect trust, responsiveness and dedication from our clients in return. Our best results happen when both teams care about the outcome and work toward the same goal.
FounderLetter.name: Maria Sivkova
FounderLetter.role: Owner and Managing Director, Conversion Century

Testimonial17.heading: What our clients say about working with us

hero.heading: People With Ideas and Energy. A Team That Moves Your Business Forward.
hero.body:
Conversion Century is a boutique SEO agency based in Sofia. We work with businesses across Europe and the United States, helping them turn organic search into an opportunity for growth.

Since 2016, we have combined technical expertise, professional content and strategic thinking. Today, we apply that experience across search engines and AI search to connect businesses with the people looking for their products and services.
hero.imageAlt: The Conversion Century team working together around a futuristic table

2016.title: The Start of a Specialist SEO Agency
2016.content: Nick Gerdzhikov founded Conversion Century in Bulgaria in February 2016. From the very beginning, the agency had a clear direction: to bring research, website optimisation, content and link building together around clients’ business goals.

2017.title: First Steps in the United States
2017.content: We began working with clients in the US and entered a new competitive environment. These first international projects broadened our perspective and shaped our approach to working across different markets.

2018.title: Larger Clients and Local Partnerships
2018.content: Our portfolio in Bulgaria grew to include larger, established companies. We also began working with local agencies, contributing SEO expertise to projects that brought together marketing, design and website development.

2019.title: Supporting Growth in Europe
2019.content: We moved into new European markets alongside Bulgarian brands and helped them reach audiences beyond their home country. Researching local search and adapting websites for different markets became an increasingly important part of our work.

2020.title: A Growing Business and a New Team Member
2020.content: As the agency developed, we strengthened our client relationships and the processes behind our daily work. Maria Sivkova joined the team. She started as an intern and became the agency’s owner two years later.

2021.title: Our First Office in Sofia
2021.content: We opened our first office in Sofia, creating a place where the team works, exchanges ideas and learns together. We also began documenting more of our processes so practical experience could be shared more easily across projects.

2022.title: New Owner, Same Drive to Grow
2022.content:
After Nick moved to the United States, Maria acquired Conversion Century and took over the leadership of the agency.

We continued developing our international presence and our working methods. Our partnership with MUZE also brought us closer to complementary expertise in creative projects, marketing and influencer communications.

2023.title: Bringing Our Expertise Together
2023.content: We focused on building a stronger connection between research, technical SEO, content and authority building. Clearer priorities and closer coordination helped us develop long-term relationships with clients and partner agencies.

2024.title: Investing in Tools and International Training
2024.content: We became official partners of Ahrefs and Semrush and expanded international SEO training for the team. Ongoing learning gives us a stronger shared foundation and gives every specialist the chance to develop their expertise.

2025.title: A More Specialised Team
2025.content: Our team reached 10 people, with distinct roles in SEO, technical optimisation, content management and copywriting. This structure gives specialists more ownership of their work and keeps collaboration at the centre of every project.

2026.title: Our Strongest Year Yet
2026.content:
In our tenth year, our client portfolio continues to grow and our direction for the future is clear.

We are developing our approach to visibility in AI search, exploring new tools and adapting to changes in how people discover businesses. We also continue to invest in technical foundations, content quality and a better understanding of our clients’ business goals.

people.heading: The People Behind Conversion Century
people.lead: Our team includes SEO and technical specialists, content managers and professional copywriters.
people.body:
Each of us brings a different perspective to the shared project. Search research helps us create content. Technical decisions affect how easily a website can be discovered. Clear information helps visitors understand what a business offers and decide whether to get in touch.

Clients communicate directly with the people responsible for their projects, including the owner and experienced content specialists. Within the team, we share what we learn, discuss important decisions and help each other develop.

leadership.heading: Maria Sivkova on People, Business and Trust
leadership.intro: Maria joined Conversion Century in 2020 and became the agency’s owner in 2022. With more than eight years of experience in HR, marketing and digital, she combines her business knowledge with the ability to build and develop a team.
leadership.quote:
Conversion Century is much more than a company to me. I have grown alongside the agency, dedicated my career to SEO, which helps businesses reach more people online, and built a team that gets excited about the businesses we work with. I take part in projects personally because I want to know the people behind them and the goals we are working towards.

When a client comes to us, I want to understand what they are building, what matters to them and what success looks like for their business. I often catch myself thinking about their website, asking questions and looking for ways to make it better.

I also believe a good partnership needs honest conversations. We take on projects where we think we can contribute, and our work is at its most rewarding with clients who are ready to share their knowledge, discuss challenges openly and grow together with us.

markets.heading: From Bulgaria to International Markets
markets.lead: We support Bulgarian businesses expanding into international markets and international companies building a presence in Bulgaria and other European countries.

collaboration.heading: Close Collaboration. Shared Ambition.
collaboration.lead: A website can tell us a lot about a business. The people behind it can tell us even more.
collaboration.body:
We take the time to understand who your customers are and what your business priorities and ambitions are before deciding where to focus. That knowledge guides our research, shapes our recommendations and helps us make better decisions as the work progresses.

Our team is deliberately small, and experienced specialists work closely together on every project. You can talk directly to the people doing the work, while we share responsibility and bring our different perspectives together.

We are curious about our clients’ challenges and always looking to get better at what we do. You can expect considered questions, attention to detail and a team that takes responsibility for keeping the work moving forward.

mission.statement: To help businesses build a lasting presence with real business value wherever their customers look for information.
mission.body:
We make complex search challenges easier to understand and easier to solve. Through research, technical improvements, useful content and authority building, we help clients present their expertise, products and services to the people looking for them.

For us, success means reaching the right audience and helping people take the next step: an enquiry, a consultation, an application or a purchase.

understand.title: Understand First, Then Recommend
understand.content: We get to know your business, audience and website before deciding what needs to change. Our recommendations take your goals, resources and opportunities into account.

ownership.title: Take Responsibility
ownership.content: We deliver on our commitments, raise questions early and stay involved while recommendations are put into practice. For us, the work doesn’t end when a task is handed over.

communicate.title: Communicate Clearly
communicate.content: You should know what we are doing, why it matters and how we will evaluate progress. We share our research findings, explain limitations and talk openly about priorities.

longTerm.title: Work With the Future in Mind
longTerm.content: We use established SEO methods and focus on useful content, accessible websites and authority building. Every improvement should contribute to a stronger presence over the long term.

learning.title: Learn and Try New Approaches
learning.content: Search is changing, and we are developing along with it. We invest in training, share knowledge and critically evaluate new tools before making them part of our work.

partners.title: Work as Partners
partners.content: Your team knows your business in a way we never could, and that knowledge makes our work better. Some of our client relationships have lasted more than seven years, built on collaboration, consistency and a shared drive to grow.

partners.heading: Certified agency partners
partners.body: We are an official agency partner of Ahrefs and Semrush, two of the most widely used SEO platforms. That gives our team deep, hands-on expertise with the data and tools behind every audit, strategy and report we deliver.
